interpretation: Independent sampling outside Docker stalls with ROS/container sampling. This localizes reproduced long gaps beyond individual ROS callbacks; physical-host/hypervisor scheduling and clock behavior are not distinguished.
parameter_capture_note: Natural captures retain startup parameter snapshots and exact parameter_update records in trace.jsonl (initial_passengers becomes 0 before seed-300 reset). Controlled captures snapshot applied parameters.
retained_failures: Initial preflight goal rejection after a 6.6-second shared gap; campaign interrupted to correct 2 Hz arrival false detections and reuse the readiness wait.

Initial real-sampler test assumed an uninterrupted host; a concurrent VM-host gap invalidated that assumption (12.580 s test duration). The test now asserts the classification supported by measured host timing rather than assuming clean scheduling.
